# Client Portal — API endpoints (mobile app ke liye)

Generated 2026-10-22 from the client portal code (`crmfronend` + `crmwebadmin`) and live calls on the local server.
Flow guide (kaunsi screen par kaunsi API, kis order me): [user-guide.md](user-guide.md)

## Is file ko kaise padhein

- Har API ek baar likhi hai — jis screen par pehli baar aati hai wahan. Baaki screens par link hai.
- **Success response** me jahan "Live response" likha hai, wo local server par asli call ka jawab hai — Postman me bhi yahi aayega. Arrays me 2 rows rakhi hain, par har field dikhaya hai.
- **Key detail** table me har key ka matlab hai. **Next API** = ye value aage kis API me bhejni hai. `frontend-verified` = web portal ka code padh kar pakka kiya; `confirmed` = live call me wahi value dono APIs me mili; `same field name` = sirf naam se match, page flow me check karo.
- `null` jahan dikhe, API sach me `null` bhejti hai — app me handle karo.
- Base URL: `{{baseUrl}}` = broker ka CRM domain (jaise `https://crm.<broker>.com`).

## Common headers

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Authorization | Bearer `<token>` (login API se milta hai; public APIs me nahi bhejna) |
| Accept | application/json |
| Content-Type | application/json (file upload me multipart/form-data) |
| Accept-Language | en |

## Auth (Login / Register / OTP / Password)

### Login — `/login`

#### GET /api/user/auth/google/redirect

**Overview**

Ye API data laati hai. Client portal me **Login, Register** screen par use hoti hai (`/login, /register`); frontend me `handleGoogleLogin` se call hoti hai.

**Endpoint**

- Method: `GET`
- URL: `/api/user/auth/google/redirect`
- Auth: Public (token nahi chahiye)
- Backend: `GoogleAuthController@redirectToGoogle` — `core/app/Http/Controllers/User/GoogleAuthController.php:52-141`

**Headers**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Accept | application/json |

**Request params**

NONE

#### Success response (200)

_Ye response code se liya gaya hai — local par is API ka success live nahi chal saka (trade engine / bahar ki service / admin step chahiye). `"..."` = value runtime par aati hai._

Source: `core/app/Http/Controllers/User/GoogleAuthController.php:119`
```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "success": true,
  "message": "Redirect URL generated",
  "data": {
    "auth_url": "..."
  }
}
```

**Key detail**

| Key | Key detail |
|---|---|
| `data.auth_url` | auth ka link — e.g. `"..."` |

#### Error responses

- **403** — live call ka asli jawab (local server, 2026-10-22):

```json
{
  "status": false,
  "success": false,
  "message": "Google SSO is not enabled",
  "data": []
}
```

Code me ye error cases hain (`success: false`):

  - `403` — Google SSO is not enabled
  - `500` — Google OAuth is not properly configured. Please contact administrator.
  - `500` — ($errorMessage, false, $errorData, 500)

#### POST /api/user/auth/google/verify-login-otp

**Overview**

Ye API naya kaam / request bhejti hai. Client portal me **Login** screen par use hoti hai (`/login`); frontend me `handleVerify` se call hoti hai.

**Endpoint**

- Method: `POST`
- URL: `/api/user/auth/google/verify-login-otp`
- Auth: Public (token nahi chahiye)
- Backend: `GoogleAuthController@verifyLoginOTP` — `core/app/Http/Controllers/User/GoogleAuthController.php:617-669`

**Headers**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Accept | application/json |

**Request params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string (email) | Yes | Email address — rule: `required\|email` | "user@gmail.com" |
| `otp_code` | string | Yes | OTP code (mail ya Google Authenticator se) — rule: `required\|string\|size:6` | "678100" |

#### Success response (200)

_Live response — `POST /api/user/auth/google/verify-login-otp` on the local server, 2026-10-22. Arrays trimmed to 2 rows; every field is shown._

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "success": true,
  "message": "OTP verified successfully",
  "data": {
    "user": {
      "id": 9,
      "email": "user@gmail.com",
      "email_verified_at": "2026-07-31T07:12:17+00:00",
      "created_at": "2026-07-22T07:08:52+00:00",
      "updated_at": "2026-10-22T06:38:39+00:00",
      "user_slug": "UWNtb52I",
      "first_name": "shubham",
      "last_name": "yadav",
      "mobile": "999937289",
      "mobile_verified_at": "2026-07-31 07:12:17",
      "status": "active",
      "google_avatar": "",
      "google_otp_enabled": true,
      "google_otp_required": false,
      "reg_complete": 1,
      "internal_transfer_enabled": 1,
      "deleted_at": ""
    },
    "token": "1539|ppuOD7Qr5K3YFMAbgtmxAr2JEkRBP8NifhZiSEDzdc7b5580",
    "websocket_token": "0335fddbb26d127f77a62e0016dab77271583da3ccff0c9ff325092a5a1ae5f2",
    "redirect": "http://crm.forex.com/dashboard"
  }
}
```

**Key detail**

| Key | Key detail |
|---|---|
| `data.user` | User (group of fields) |
| `data.user.id` | Is record ka database id — detail / edit / delete wali APIs me yahi bhejte hain — e.g. `9` |
| `data.user.email` | Email address — e.g. `"user@gmail.com"` |
| `data.user.email_verified_at` | email verified kab hua (date/time) — e.g. `"2026-07-31T07:12:17+00:00"` |
| `data.user.created_at` | Kab bana (date/time ya "2 weeks ago" jaisa text) — e.g. `"2026-07-22T07:08:52+00:00"` |
| `data.user.updated_at` | Aakhri baar kab badla — e.g. `"2026-10-22T06:38:39+00:00"` |
| `data.user.user_slug` | User ka public code (slug) — documents / images ke URL me use hota hai — e.g. `"UWNtb52I"` |
| `data.user.first_name` | User ka pehla naam — e.g. `"shubham"` |
| `data.user.last_name` | User ka surname — e.g. `"yadav"` |
| `data.user.mobile` | Mobile number (country code ke bina) — e.g. `"999937289"` |
| `data.user.mobile_verified_at` | mobile verified kab hua (date/time) — e.g. `"2026-07-31 07:12:17"` |
| `data.user.status` | Request ka result: `true` = kaam ho gaya, `false` = kaam nahi hua. Kuch purani APIs yahan HTTP code (jaise `200`) bhejti hain — e.g. `"active"` |
| `data.user.google_avatar` | Google avatar (text) — e.g. `""` |
| `data.user.google_otp_enabled` | User ne Google Authenticator (2FA) chalu kiya hai ya nahi — e.g. `true` |
| `data.user.google_otp_required` | Login / transaction par Google OTP maangna zaroori hai ya nahi — e.g. `false` |
| `data.user.reg_complete` | Registration poora hua ya nahi (1 / 0) — e.g. `1` |
| `data.user.internal_transfer_enabled` | Internal transfer chalu hai ya nahi — e.g. `1` |
| `data.user.deleted_at` | Kab delete hua (khaali = delete nahi hua) — e.g. `""` |
| `data.token` | Token (text) — e.g. `"1539|ppuOD7Qr5K3YFMAbgtmxA…"` |
| `data.websocket_token` | Websocket token (text) — e.g. `"0335fddbb26d127f77a62e0016…"` |
| `data.redirect` | Redirect (text) — e.g. `"http://crm.forex.com/dashb…"` |

#### Error responses

Code me ye error cases hain (`success: false`):

  - `422` — Validation failed
  - `404` — User not found
  - `400` — Google OTP is not enabled for this account
  - `401` — Invalid OTP code
  - `500` — Failed to verify OTP:

#### POST /api/user/login

**Overview**

Ye API naya kaam / request bhejti hai. Client portal me **Login, Auto-login from landing site** screen par use hoti hai (`/login, /auth/from-net`); frontend me `handleLogin` se call hoti hai.

**Endpoint**

- Method: `POST`
- URL: `/api/user/login`
- Auth: Public (token nahi chahiye)
- Backend: `AuthController@login` — `core/app/Http/Controllers/User/AuthController.php:236-438`

**Headers**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Accept | application/json |

**Request params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `password` | string | Yes | Password — rule: `required` | "wrong-password-probe" |
| `fcm_token` | string | No | Push notification ke liye device ka FCM token — rule: `nullable\|string\|max:2000` |  |
| `device_type` | string | No | Device ka type (android / ios / web) — rule: `nullable\|string\|in:android,ios` | "web" |
| `email` | string | No | Email address | "user@gmail.com" |

#### Success response (200)

_Ye response code se liya gaya hai — local par is API ka success live nahi chal saka (trade engine / bahar ki service / admin step chahiye). `"..."` = value runtime par aati hai._

Source: `core/app/Http/Controllers/User/AuthController.php:342`
```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "success": true,
  "message": "Google Authenticator setup is required",
  "data": {
    "requires_google_otp_setup": "...",
    "email": "..."
  }
}
```

Source: `core/app/Http/Controllers/User/AuthController.php:349`
```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "success": true,
  "message": "Two-factor authentication required",
  "data": {
    "requires_google_otp": "...",
    "email": "..."
  }
}
```

Source: `core/app/Http/Controllers/User/AuthController.php:396`
```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "success": true,
  "message": "auth.sign_in",
  "data": {
    "user": "...",
    "token": "...",
    "websocket_token": "...",
    "redirect": "..."
  }
}
```

**Key detail**

| Key | Key detail |
|---|---|
| `data.requires_google_otp_setup` | Requires google otp setup (text) — e.g. `"..."` |
| `data.email` | Email address — e.g. `"..."` |

#### Error responses

- **429** — bahut zyada requests ek saath. Thodi der baad dobara try karo.

- **200** — live call ka asli jawab (local server, 2026-10-22):

```json
{
  "status": false,
  "success": false,
  "message": "",
  "data": []
}
```

  Request jo bheji gayi thi:

```json
{
  "email": "user@gmail.com",
  "password": "wrong-password-probe",
  "fcm_token": "",
  "device_type": "web"
}
```

- URL: `/api/ibm/r/{code}`

**Headers**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Accept | application/json |

**Request params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | Yes | (path) Code (referral / link code) — rule: `URL path parameter` — value [`GET /api/ibm/portal/links`](#get-api-ibm-portal-links) ke `data.links[].code` se aati hai | "INSTA" |

#### GET /api/user/json

**Overview**

Ye API data laati hai. Client portal me **Register, Complete Registration (Google signup)** screen par use hoti hai (`/register, /complete-registration`).

**Endpoint**

- Method: `GET`
- URL: `/api/user/json`
- Auth: Public (token nahi chahiye)

**Headers**

| `data.alert.triggered_at` | triggered kab hua (date/time) — e.g. `""` |
| `data.alert.triggered_price` | Triggered price (text) — e.g. `""` |
| `data.alert.fcm_token` | Push notification ke liye device ka FCM token — e.g. `"probe-fcm"` |
| `data.alert.device_type` | Device ka type (android / ios / web) — e.g. `"android"` |
| `data.alert.message` | Server ka message — user ko toast / alert me dikhane ke liye — e.g. `"Probe alert updated"` |
| `data.alert.created_at` | Kab bana (date/time ya "2 weeks ago" jaisa text) — e.g. `"2026-10-22T06:16:48+00:00"` |
| `data.alert.updated_at` | Aakhri baar kab badla — e.g. `"2026-10-22T06:16:48+00:00"` |

#### Error responses

- **401** — token missing / expired. App ko login screen par bhejo.

```json
{
  "message": "Unauthenticated",
  "status": false
}
```

Code me ye error cases hain (`success: false`):

  - `404` — Price Alerts module is disabled
  - `404` — Price alert not found
  - `400` — Cannot update a triggered alert
  - `422` — Validation failed

**Headers**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Authorization | Bearer `<token>` |
| Accept | application/json |

**Request params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mt5_account_id` | integer | Yes | MT5 account (number ya id — API ke hisaab se) — rule: `required` | 2000013 |
| `withdrawal_method_id` | string | Conditional | withdrawal method ka id — rule: `
                    sometimes,
                    Rule::requiredIf(function () use ($request) {
                        return $request->withdrawal_method_id != 0;
                    }),
                    function ($attribute, $value, $fail) use ($request, $user) {
                        if ($request->withdrawal_method_id != 0) {
                            $exists = \App\Models\User\UserWithdrawal::where(withdrawal_slug, $value)
                                ->where(user_id, $user->id)
                                ->exists();
                            if (! $exists) {
                                $fail(The selected $attribute is invalid.);
                            }
                        }
                    },
                ` | "local-method" |
| `withdrawal_method_slug` | string | No | withdrawal method ka code (slug) — rule: `nullable, string, max:64` |  |
| `amount` | number | Yes | Amount (kai jagah currency sign ke saath text, jaise "$150.00") — rule: `required\|numeric\|min:0.01` | 20 |
| `user_input_net_amount` | number | No | user input net ki raqam — rule: `nullable\|numeric\|min:0.01` | 20 |
| `user_input_currency` | string | No | User input currency (text) — rule: `nullable\|string\|max:50` | "USD" |
| `master_withdrawal_method_slug` | string | No | master withdrawal method ka code (slug) | "local-method" |
| `otp` | string | No | User ko mail / SMS par aaya OTP | "957377" |

| `data.userMT5Accounts[].balance` | Account / wallet ka balance — e.g. `"662.27"` |
| `data.userMT5Accounts[].credit` | Bonus / credit amount jo account me hai (credit ho to kuch transfers block ho sakte hain) — e.g. `50` |
| `data.userMT5Accounts[].has_credit` | Account me credit hai ya nahi — `true` ho to transfer block ho sakta hai — e.g. `false` |
| `data.userMT5Accounts[].transfer_blocked_reason` | Transfer kyun block hai (khaali = block nahi) — e.g. `""` |
| `data.userMT5Accounts[].available_for_transfer` | Is account se abhi kitna transfer ho sakta hai — e.g. `0` |
| `data.userMT5Accounts[].currency` | Currency (jaise `USD`, `USC` = US cent) — e.g. `"USD"` |
| `data.userMT5Accounts[].is_cent_account` | Cent account hai ya nahi (cent me balance 100 guna dikhta hai) — e.g. `false` |
| `data.wallet` | Wallet (group of fields) |
| `data.wallet.wallet_id` | wallet ka id — e.g. `"3073238397"` — **Next API:** [`POST /api/user/internaltransfer/request`](#post-api-user-internaltransfer-request) (`to_account`, `from_account`, body; frontend-verified) |

| `data.ibaccount.reference_link_id` | IB ka referral code — e.g. `"IB_016730"` |

| `data.ibmWallet` | Ibm Wallet (text) — e.g. `""` |
| `data.ibmWallets` | Ibm Wallets ki list |

| `data[].avatar` | Profile photo ka URL — e.g. `"/assets/avatar-default.svg"` |
| `data[].parent_ib` | Upar wala (parent) IB — e.g. `"Test One"` |

#### Error responses

- **401** — token missing / expired. App ko login screen par bhejo.

```json
{
  "message": "Unauthenticated",
  "status": false
}
```

- **429** — bahut zyada requests ek saath. Thodi der baad dobara try karo.

Code me ye error cases hain (`success: false`):

  - `404` — Sub-IB not found or access denied
  - `500` — Failed to get Sub IB Sub IBs:

### Sub IB Approval — `/sub-ib-approval`

#### GET /api/user/ib/get-structure-options/{id}

**Overview**

Ye API data laati hai. Client portal me **Sub IB Approval** screen par use hoti hai (`/sub-ib-approval`); frontend me `openReasonModal` se call hoti hai.

**Endpoint**

- Method: `GET`
- URL: `/api/user/ib/get-structure-options/{id}`
- Auth: Bearer token (`auth:sanctum`)
- Backend: `IbaController@getIBStructureOptions` — `core/app/Http/Controllers/User/IbaController.php:2844-2857`

**Headers**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Authorization | Bearer `<token>` |
| Accept | application/json |

**Request params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Yes | (path) Is record ka database id — detail / edit / delete wali APIs me yahi bhejte hain — rule: `URL path parameter` | "26" |

#### Success response (200)

_Ye response code se liya gaya hai — local par is API ka success live nahi chal saka (trade engine / bahar ki service / admin step chahiye). `"..."` = value runtime par aati hai._

Source: `core/app/Http/Controllers/User/IbaController.php:2852`
```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "success": true,
  "message": "Content rendered successfully",
  "data": {
    "html": "..."
  }
}
```

|---|---|
| `data.html` | Html (text) — e.g. `"..."` |

- **401** — token missing / expired. App ko login screen par bhejo.

```json
  "message": "Unauthenticated",
  "status": false
}
```

- **429** — bahut zyada requests ek saath. Thodi der baad dobara try karo.

- **404** — live call ka asli jawab (local server, 2026-10-22):

```json

  "status": false,
  "success": false,
  "message": "IB request not found",
  "data": []
}
```

  - — ($result['message'], false, [], $result['code'])

| `default_plan_group_id` | integer | No | default plan group ka id — rule: `nullable, integer` | 57 |

#### Success response (200)

_Live response — `POST /api/ibm/portal/client-visibility` on the local server, 2026-10-22. Arrays trimmed to 2 rows; every field is shown._

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Saved.",
  "data": {
    "plan_group_ids": [
      57,
      58
    ],
    "default_plan_group_id": 57
  }
}
```

**Key detail**

| Key | Key detail |
|---|---|
| `data.plan_group_ids` | plan group ke ids ki list |
| `data.default_plan_group_id` | default plan group ka id — e.g. `57` |

#### Error responses

- **401** — token missing / expired. App ko login screen par bhejo.

```json
{
  "message": "Unauthenticated",
  "status": false
}
```

Code me ye error cases hain (`success: false`):

  - `422` — Leave at least one group on, or your clients cannot open an account.
  - `422` — One or more of the selected groups is not on your plan.
  - `422` — The default group must be one of the groups you are showing.

### Become a manager (apply) — `/pmam/manager/apply`

#### POST /api/user/pmam/manager/apply

**Overview**

Ye API naya kaam / request bhejti hai. Client portal me **Become a manager (apply)** screen par use hoti hai (`/pmam/manager/apply`); frontend me `handleSubmit` se call hoti hai.

**Endpoint**

- Method: `POST`
- URL: `/api/user/pmam/manager/apply`
- Auth: Bearer token (`auth:sanctum`)
- Backend: `PmamApiController@applyAsManager` — `core/Modules/PMAM/app/Http/Controllers/Api/PmamApiController.php:191-247`

**Headers**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Authorization | Bearer `<token>` |
| Accept | application/json |

**Request params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `terms_accepted` | boolean | Yes | User ne terms accept kiye (`true`) — rule: `required\|accepted` | true |

#### Success response (200)

_Ye response code se liya gaya hai — local par is API ka success live nahi chal saka (trade engine / bahar ki service / admin step chahiye). `"..."` = value runtime par aati hai._

Source: `core/Modules/PMAM/app/Http/Controllers/Api/PmamApiController.php:246`
```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "success": true,
  "message": "Manager application submitted successfully.",
  "data": {
    "status": "..."
  }
}
```

**Key detail**

| Key | Key detail |
|---|---|
| `data.status` | Request ka result: `true` = kaam ho gaya, `false` = kaam nahi hua. Kuch purani APIs yahan HTTP code (jaise `200`) bhejti hain — e.g. `"..."` |

#### Error responses

- **401** — token missing / expired. App ko login screen par bhejo.

```json
{
  "message": "Unauthenticated",
  "status": false
}
```

- **422** — live call ka asli jawab (local server, 2026-10-22):

```json
{
  "status": false,
  "success": false,
  "message": "You already have an active manager application.",
  "data": []
}
```

  Request jo bheji gayi thi:

```json
{
  "terms_accepted": true
}
```

Code me ye error cases hain (`success: false`):

  - `422` — ($masterEnrollmentChk['message'] ?? 'New PAMM master enrollments are currently disabled.', false, [], 422)
  - `422` — IB partners cannot become PMAM managers. Roles are mutually exclusive.
  - `422` — You already have an active manager application.
  - `422` — ($steps['message'], false, [], 422)

#### POST /api/user/pmam/manager/plans/{planId}/inactivate

**Overview**

Ye API naya kaam / request bhejti hai. Client portal me **Manager — My Plans** screen par use hoti hai (`/pmam/manager/plans`); frontend me `confirmInactivate` se call hoti hai.

**Endpoint**

- Auth: Bearer token (`auth:sanctum`)

**Headers**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Authorization | Bearer `<token>` |
| Accept | application/json |

**Request params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `planId` | string | Yes | (path) Plan Id (text) — rule: `URL path parameter` — value [`GET /api/user/pmam/investor/enrollments`](#get-api-user-pmam-investor-enrollments) ke `data[].plan_id` se aati hai | "1" |

#### Success response (200)

_Ye response code se liya gaya hai — local par is API ka success live nahi chal saka (trade engine / bahar ki service / admin step chahiye). `"..."` = value runtime par aati hai._

```json

  "status": 200,
  "success": true,
  "message": "Plan inactivated successfully.",

    "status": "..."
  }
}
```

|---|---|
| `data.status` | Request ka result: `true` = kaam ho gaya, `false` = kaam nahi hua. Kuch purani APIs yahan HTTP code (jaise `200`) bhejti hain — e.g. `"..."` |

#### Error responses

- **401** — token missing / expired. App ko login screen par bhejo.

```json
{
  "message": "Unauthenticated",
  "status": false
}
```

- **422** — live call ka asli jawab (local server, 2026-10-22):

```json
{
  "status": false,
  "success": false,
  "message": "Cannot inactivate: plan has 3 active investor(s) with $202,715.35 AUM.",
  "data": {
    "active_investors": 3,
    "total_aum": 202715.35000000003
  }
}
```

Code me ye error cases hain (`success: false`):

  - `422` — Plan is already inactive.
  - `422` — Only approved or paused plans can be inactivated.
  - `422` — ( sprintf('Cannot inactivate: plan has %d active investor(s) with $%s AUM.', $activeInvestorCount, number_format($totalAum, 2)), false, ['ac

|---|---|

| `overrides_sl_tp` | boolean | No | Overrides sl tp (text) — rule: `nullable\|boolean` |  |
| `sl_tp_mode` | string | No | Sl tp mode (text) — rule: `nullable\|in:pip,dollar` |  |
| `take_profit_pips` | number | No | Take profit (pips me) — rule: `nullable\|numeric\|min:1\|max:10000` |  |

#### POST /api/user/copytrading/master/apply

**Overview**

Ye API naya kaam / request bhejti hai. Client portal me **Master dashboard, Master dashboard (legacy)** screen par use hoti hai (`/copy-trading/master/dashboard, /copy-trading/master/dashboard/legacy`); frontend me `submitApply` se call hoti hai.

**Endpoint**

- Method: `POST`
- URL: `/api/user/copytrading/master/apply`
- Auth: Bearer token (`auth:sanctum`)
- Backend: `CopyTradingApiController@applyAsMaster` — `core/Modules/CopyTrading/app/Http/Controllers/Api/CopyTradingApiController.php:376-446`

**Headers**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Authorization | Bearer `<token>` |
| Accept | application/json |

**Request params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `terms_accepted` | boolean | Yes | User ne terms accept kiye (`true`) — rule: `required\|accepted` | true |
| `nickname` | string | Yes | Nickname (text) — rule: `required\|string\|max:100` | "Probe master" |
| `strategy` | string | No | Strategy (text) — rule: `nullable\|string\|max:2000` | "api doc probe" |
| `risk_info` | string | No | Risk info (text) — rule: `nullable\|string\|max:2000` | "api doc probe" |

#### Success response (200)

_Ye response code se liya gaya hai — local par is API ka success live nahi chal saka (trade engine / bahar ki service / admin step chahiye). `"..."` = value runtime par aati hai._

Source: `core/Modules/CopyTrading/app/Http/Controllers/Api/CopyTradingApiController.php:442`
```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "success": true,
  "message": "Master application submitted successfully.",
  "data": {
    "status": "...",
    "master_code": "..."
  }
}
```

**Key detail**

| Key | Key detail |
|---|---|
| `data.status` | Request ka result: `true` = kaam ho gaya, `false` = kaam nahi hua. Kuch purani APIs yahan HTTP code (jaise `200`) bhejti hain — e.g. `"..."` |
| `data.master_code` | Copy-trading master ka code — master profile API me bhejte hain — e.g. `"..."` |

#### Error responses

- **401** — token missing / expired. App ko login screen par bhejo.

```json
{
  "message": "Unauthenticated",
  "status": false
}
```

- **422** — live call ka asli jawab (local server, 2026-10-22):

```json
{
  "status": false,
  "success": false,
  "message": "You already have an active master application.",
  "data": []
}
```

  Request jo bheji gayi thi:

```json
{
  "terms_accepted": true,
  "nickname": "Probe master",
  "strategy": "api doc probe",
  "risk_info": "api doc probe"
}
```

Code me ye error cases hain (`success: false`):

  - `422` — ($gate['message'], false, [], 422)
  - `422` — Your master account has been deactivated by the administrator. Please contact support to have it reactivated.
  - `422` — You already have an active master application.
  - `422` — ($steps['message'], false, [], 422)

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |

### Bonus — `/bonus`

#### GET /api/user/bonus

**Overview**

Ye API data laati hai. Client portal me **Bonus** screen par use hoti hai (`/bonus`); frontend me `fetchBonuses` se call hoti hai.

**Endpoint**

- Method: `GET`
- URL: `/api/user/bonus`
- Auth: Bearer token (`auth:sanctum`)
- Backend: `BonusController@index` — `core/app/Http/Controllers/User/BonusController.php:18-133`

**Headers**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Authorization | Bearer `<token>` |
| Accept | application/json |

**Request params**

NONE

#### POST /api/user/bonus/bonusClaim

**Overview**

Ye API naya kaam / request bhejti hai. Client portal me **Bonus** screen par use hoti hai (`/bonus`); frontend me `confirmClaim` se call hoti hai.

**Endpoint**

- Method: `POST`
- URL: `/api/user/bonus/bonusClaim`
- Auth: Bearer token (`auth:sanctum`)
- Backend: `BonusController@bonusClaim` — `core/app/Http/Controllers/User/BonusController.php:135-466`

**Headers**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Authorization | Bearer `<token>` |
| Accept | application/json |

**Request params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deposit_id` | integer | Yes | deposit ka id — rule: `required` | 99 |
| `bonus_id` | integer | Yes | bonus ka id — rule: `required` | 2 |

#### Success response (200)

_Live response — `POST /api/user/bonus/bonusClaim` on the local server, 2026-10-22. Arrays trimmed to 2 rows; every field is shown._

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "success": true,
  "message": "Bonus request submitted — pending approval",
  "data": {
    "user_bonus_id": 31,
    "status": "pending"
  }
}
```

**Key detail**

| Key | Key detail |
|---|---|
| `data.user_bonus_id` | user bonus ka id — e.g. `31` |
| `data.status` | Request ka result: `true` = kaam ho gaya, `false` = kaam nahi hua. Kuch purani APIs yahan HTTP code (jaise `200`) bhejti hain — e.g. `"pending"` |

#### Error responses

- **401** — token missing / expired. App ko login screen par bhejo.

```json
{
  "message": "Unauthenticated",
  "status": false
}
```

- **429** — bahut zyada requests ek saath. Thodi der baad dobara try karo.

Code me ye error cases hain (`success: false`):

  - `429` — Another bonus claim is already being processed for your account. Please wait a moment.
  - `400` — Bonus request already exists
  - `403` — Auto-bonus is disabled for your account. Please contact support.
  - `403` — Invalid deposit
  - `400` — Bonus is not available
  - `400` — This bonus is outside its active period

#### POST /api/user/bonus/bonusClaimCancel

**Overview**

Ye API naya kaam / request bhejti hai. Client portal me **Bonus** screen par use hoti hai (`/bonus`); frontend me `confirmCancelBonus` se call hoti hai.

**Endpoint**

- Method: `POST`
- URL: `/api/user/bonus/bonusClaimCancel`
- Auth: Bearer token (`auth:sanctum`)
- Backend: `BonusController@cancelBonus` — `core/app/Http/Controllers/User/BonusController.php:528-628`

**Headers**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Authorization | Bearer `<token>` |
| Accept | application/json |

**Request params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | Yes | Is record ka database id — detail / edit / delete wali APIs me yahi bhejte hain — rule: `required\|exists:user_bonus,id` | 4 |
| `reason` | string | No | Kaaran (reason) — rule: `nullable\|string\|max:500` | "api doc probe" |

#### Success response (200)

_Ye response code se liya gaya hai — local par is API ka success live nahi chal saka (trade engine / bahar ki service / admin step chahiye). `"..."` = value runtime par aati hai._

Source: `core/app/Http/Controllers/User/BonusController.php:624`
```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "success": true,
  "message": "Bonus cancelled successfully.",
  "data": "<null>"
}
```

#### Error responses

- **401** — token missing / expired. App ko login screen par bhejo.

```json
{
  "message": "Unauthenticated",
  "status": false
}
```

- **429** — bahut zyada requests ek saath. Thodi der baad dobara try karo.

- **400** — live call ka asli jawab (local server, 2026-10-22):

```json
{
  "status": false,
  "success": false,
  "message": "Something went wrong",
  "data": []
}
```

  Request jo bheji gayi thi:

```json
{
  "id": 4,
  "reason": "api doc probe"
}
```

Code me ye error cases hain (`success: false`):

  - `404` — Bonus record not found or access denied.
  - `400` — Only pending or claimed bonuses can be cancelled.
  - `400` — Cannot cancel a bonus that has already been converted to balance.
  - `404` — MT5 account not found.
  - `400` — Failed to remove bonus from MT5: 
  - `500` — Failed to submit cancel request:

#### GET /api/user/demo-contest/{contestId}/terms

**Overview**

Ye API data laati hai. Client portal me **Demo Contest list, Demo Contest detail** screen par use hoti hai (`/demo-contest, /demo-contest/:id`); frontend me `proceedAfterTasks` se call hoti hai.

**Endpoint**

- Method: `GET`
- URL: `/api/user/demo-contest/{contestId}/terms`
- Auth: Bearer token (`auth:sanctum`)
- Backend: `DemoContestApiController@getTerms` — `core/Modules/DemoContest/app/Http/Controllers/Api/DemoContestApiController.php:532-544`

**Headers**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Authorization | Bearer `<token>` |
| Accept | application/json |

**Request params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `contestId` | string | Yes | (path) Contest Id (text) — rule: `URL path parameter` — value [`GET /api/user/demo-contest/my-stats`](#get-api-user-demo-contest-my-stats) ke `data.participant.contest_id` se aati hai | "2" |

#### Success response (200)

_Live response — `GET /api/user/demo-contest/2/terms` on the local server, 2026-10-22. Arrays trimmed to 2 rows; every field is shown._

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "enabled": true,
  "content": "check terms and condition according to demo contest"
}
```

#### Error responses

- **401** — token missing / expired. App ko login screen par bhejo.

```json
{
  "message": "Unauthenticated",
  "status": false
}
```

Code me ye error cases hain (`success: false`):

  - `404` — (['status' => false, 'message' => 'Contest not found'], 404)

#### GET /api/user/demo-contest/{contestId}/trading-history

**Overview**

Ye API data laati hai. Client portal me **Demo Contest list, Demo Contest detail** screen par use hoti hai (`/demo-contest, /demo-contest/:id`); frontend me `loadTradingData` se call hoti hai.

**Endpoint**

- Method: `GET`
- URL: `/api/user/demo-contest/{contestId}/trading-history`
- Auth: Bearer token (`auth:sanctum`)
- Backend: `DemoContestApiController@getTradingHistory` — `core/Modules/DemoContest/app/Http/Controllers/Api/DemoContestApiController.php:724-756`

**Headers**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Authorization | Bearer `<token>` |
| Accept | application/json |

**Request params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `contestId` | string | Yes | (path) Contest Id (text) — rule: `URL path parameter` — value [`GET /api/user/demo-contest/my-stats`](#get-api-user-demo-contest-my-stats) ke `data.participant.contest_id` se aati hai | "2" |

#### Success response (200)

_Live response — `GET /api/user/demo-contest/2/trading-history` on the local server, 2026-10-22. Arrays trimmed to 2 rows; every field is shown._

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 126,
      "symbol": "XAUUSD",
      "type": "Buy",
      "lots": 40,
      "open_price": "4241.14",
      "close_price": null,
      "open_time": "2026-08-06 18:55:34",
      "close_time": null,
      "duration_min": null,
      "profit": -1941.2000000000262,
      "status": "executed",
      "close_reason": null
    },
    {
      "id": 126,
      "symbol": "XAUUSD",
      "type": "Buy",
      "lots": 40,
      "open_price": "4241.14",
      "close_price": null,
      "open_time": "2026-08-06 18:55:34",
      "close_time": null,
      "duration_min": null,
      "profit": -1941.2000000000262,
      "status": "executed",
      "close_reason": null
    }
  ],
  "total": 8,
  "account": "10414620"
}
```

**Key detail**

| Key | Key detail |
|---|---|
| `data[].id` | Is record ka database id — detail / edit / delete wali APIs me yahi bhejte hain — e.g. `126` |
| `data[].symbol` | Instrument (jaise XAUUSD, EURUSD) — e.g. `"XAUUSD"` |
| `data[].type` | Type — e.g. `"Buy"` |
| `data[].lots` | Lots — e.g. `40` |
| `data[].open_price` | Trade khulne ka price — e.g. `"4241.14"` |
| `data[].close_price` | Trade band hone ka price — e.g. `null` |
| `data[].open_time` | Trade khulne ka time — e.g. `"2026-08-06 18:55:34"` |
| `data[].close_time` | Trade band hone ka time — e.g. `null` |
| `data[].duration_min` | Duration min (null) — e.g. `null` |
| `data[].profit` | Profit / loss — e.g. `-1941.2000000000262` |
| `data[].status` | Request ka result: `true` = kaam ho gaya, `false` = kaam nahi hua. Kuch purani APIs yahan HTTP code (jaise `200`) bhejti hain — e.g. `"executed"` |
| `data[].close_reason` | Close reason (null) — e.g. `null` |

#### Error responses

- **401** — token missing / expired. App ko login screen par bhejo.

```json
{
  "message": "Unauthenticated",
  "status": false
}
```

Code me ye error cases hain (`success: false`):

  - `401` — (['status' => false, 'message' => 'Unauthenticated.'], 401)
  - `404` — (['status' => false, 'message' => 'Contest not found.'], 404)
  - `404` — (['status' => false, 'message' => 'You are not enrolled in this contest.'], 404)

#### GET /api/user/demo-contest/my-stats

**Overview**

Ye API data laati hai. Client portal me **Demo Contest list, Demo Contest detail** screen par use hoti hai (`/demo-contest, /demo-contest/:id`); frontend me `loadEnrollmentStats`, `selectContest` se call hoti hai.

**Endpoint**

- Method: `GET`
- URL: `/api/user/demo-contest/my-stats`
- Auth: Bearer token (`auth:sanctum`)
- Backend: `DemoContestApiController@getMyStats` — `core/Modules/DemoContest/app/Http/Controllers/Api/DemoContestApiController.php:549-618`

**Headers**

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| Authorization | Bearer `<token>` |
| Accept | application/json |

**Request params**

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `contest_id` | string | No | (query) Contest ka id — contest detail / enroll / claim APIs me bhejte hain — rule: `Query parameter` — value [`GET /api/user/demo-contest/contests`](#get-api-user-demo-contest-contests) ke `data[].contest.prizes[].contest_id` se aati hai | "2" |
